incidents.title: Iran asserts control over Hormuz as strikes on Bahrain, Saudi Arabia escalate
incidents.description: Iran asserted control over the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday after claiming strikes on U.S. air defense radars in Bahrain, as renewed Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia threatened to widen the regional conflict. incidents.title: Oil falls as robust Gulf exports offset Iran escalation, supply glut risks
incidents.description: Oil prices were little changed in Asian trading on Monday as renewed attacks on commercial shipping and energy infrastructure across the Persian Gulf kept supply concerns elevated, offsetting signs of resilient crude exports and expectations of a growing global supply surplus.
